_note: SPOILER-ish: hints the checker shows after a wrong answer. Kept out of tools/fde.py so learners don't read them up front.
shipped_within_1_business_day_pct: Look at your denominator and which ship date you use. And are you reading every month's file the same way?
order_status_ticket_share_pct: Count every ticket in the file, and match the category label exactly.
orders_with_backorder_line_pct: This is per order, not per line. Check how each export writes the flag, and which lines belong in the count.
scms_on_or_before_scheduled_pct: Compare 'Delivered to Client Date' with 'Scheduled Delivery Date' on every row. Check your date parsing.
scms_delivered_exactly_on_scheduled_pct: Same two columns, equal dates only.
delivered_on_time_pct: Check each delivery source on its own first: how many orders can you match, and does each source's date mean what you think?
boise_delivered_on_time_pct: Get the all-warehouse number right first, then filter.
tier1_late_credit_usd_6mo: Which orders count, and what is an order's value? Tier comes from the customer list.
